example.pinyin: shíjiān bù duō le wǒmen zhuājǐn zuò wán
example.english: We're short of time, so let's get it finished quickly.

example.hanzi: 他学习的时候非常专心。
example.pinyin: tā xuéxí de shíhou fēicháng zhuānxīn
example.english: He is completely focused when he studies.

example.hanzi: 他慢慢转动手里的杯子。
example.pinyin: tā mànmàn zhuǎndòng shǒu li de bēizi
example.english: He slowly turned the cup in his hand.

example.hanzi: 请你转告他，会议改到明天。
example.pinyin: qǐng nǐ zhuǎngào tā huìyì gǎi dào míngtiān
example.english: Please pass on to him that the meeting has moved to tomorrow.

example.hanzi: 他转身走出了办公室。
example.pinyin: tā zhuǎnshēn zǒu chū le bàngōngshì
example.english: He turned and walked out of the office.

example.hanzi: 前面路口向右转弯。
example.pinyin: qiánmiàn lùkǒu xiàng yòu zhuǎnwān
example.english: Turn right at the intersection ahead.

example.hanzi: 医生把病人转移到了别的医院。
example.pinyin: yīshēng bǎ bìngrén zhuǎnyí dào le biéde yīyuàn
example.english: The doctor had the patient transferred to another hospital.

example.hanzi: 我家的房子正在装修。
example.pinyin: wǒ jiā de fángzi zhèngzài zhuāngxiū
example.english: Our house is being renovated at the moment.

example.hanzi: 这台机器有一个安全装置。
example.pinyin: zhè tái jīqì yǒu yí ge ānquán zhuāngzhì
example.english: This machine has a safety device fitted.

example.hanzi: 年轻人应该追求自己的理想。
example.pinyin: niánqīng rén yīnggāi zhuīqiú zìjǐ de lǐxiǎng
example.english: Young people should go after their own ideals.

example.hanzi: 会议八点开始，请大家准时到。
example.pinyin: huìyì bā diǎn kāishǐ qǐng dàjiā zhǔnshí dào
example.english: The meeting starts at eight, so please be there on time.

example.hanzi: 他在图书馆查了很多资料。
example.pinyin: tā zài túshūguǎn chá le hěn duō zīliào
example.english: He looked up a lot of reference material at the library.

example.hanzi: 这个国家的水资源非常丰富。
example.pinyin: zhè ge guójiā de shuǐ zīyuán fēicháng fēngfù
example.english: This country's water resources are extremely rich.

example.hanzi: 会议自下午两点开始。
example.pinyin: huìyì zì xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn kāishǐ
example.english: The meeting runs from two in the afternoon.

example.hanzi: 他对自己的能力很自信。
example.pinyin: tā duì zìjǐ de nénglì hěn zìxìn
example.english: He is very confident in his own abilities.

example.hanzi: 英语一共有二十六个字母。
example.pinyin: Yīngyǔ yígòng yǒu èr shí liù ge zìmǔ
example.english: English has twenty-six letters in all.

example.hanzi: 综合大家的意见，我们改了计划。
example.pinyin: zōnghé dàjiā de yìjiàn wǒmen gǎi le jìhuà
example.english: Pulling everyone's views together, we revised the plan.

example.hanzi: 这次会议总共来了五十个人。
example.pinyin: zhè cì huìyì zǒnggòng lái le wǔ shí ge rén
example.english: Fifty people in all came to the meeting.

example.hanzi: 总理昨天参加了这个会议。
example.pinyin: zǒnglǐ zuótiān cānjiā le zhè ge huìyì
example.english: The premier attended the conference yesterday.

example.hanzi: 总统昨天访问了这个国家。
example.pinyin: zǒngtǒng zuótiān fǎngwèn le zhè ge guójiā
example.english: The president visited this country yesterday.

example.hanzi: 总之，这个方法比原来的更好。
example.pinyin: zǒngzhī zhè ge fāngfǎ bǐ yuánlái de gèng hǎo
example.english: In short, this method is better than the old one.

example.hanzi: 没有人能阻止他去做这件事。
example.pinyin: méiyǒu rén néng zǔzhǐ tā qù zuò zhè jiàn shì
example.english: No one could stop him from doing it.

example.hanzi: 孩子张开嘴巴让医生检查。
example.pinyin: háizi zhāng kāi zuǐba ràng yīshēng jiǎnchá
example.english: The child opened his mouth for the doctor to look.

example.hanzi: 最初我并不同意这个办法。
example.pinyin: zuìchū wǒ bìng bù tóngyì zhè ge bànfǎ
example.english: At first I did not agree with this approach.

meanings: to make a decision or choice

example.hanzi: 公司很快作出了新的决定。
example.pinyin: gōngsī hěn kuài zuòchū le xīn de juédìng
example.english: The company quickly reached a new decision.

example.hanzi: 作为经理，他必须对结果负责。
example.pinyin: zuòwéi jīnglǐ tā bìxū duì jiéguǒ fùzé
example.english: As the manager, he has to answer for the results.

meanings: to have a dream while asleep

example.hanzi: 他睡觉的时候常常做梦。
example.pinyin: tā shuìjiào de shíhou chángcháng zuòmèng
example.english: He often dreams in his sleep.
